mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below the 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 12-month MA but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal a broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face dual demand and supply shocks.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 12-month MA and INDPRO falls below 12-month MA
failure_condition: HOUST and INDPRO both fall below 12-month MA but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines but S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below the 12-month moving average signals manufacturing weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 12-month MA but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls and retail sales signal a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate hiring weaken.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 12-month MA and RSAFS falls below 12-month MA
failure_condition: PAYEMS and RSAFS both fall below 12-month MA but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions (INDPRO < 100 and declining for 3 months), falling industrial output reduces corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and declining for 3 months but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
